# Google Material Icons — replay

- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/material-design-icons/master/src/av/replay/materialicons/24px.svg
- Upstream project: https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
- License: Apache-2.0, https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/blob/master/LICENSE
- Retrieved: 2026-11-06

`replay.svg` is the original upstream 24px asset. The preview build embeds it with
an accessibility-hidden attribute and local color/size styling. Android's
`LyricsOffsetControls.ResetIcon` uses the same filled path geometry, with SVG's
smooth cubic curves expanded into explicit Android `Path` cubic curves.

Full license: `app/src/main/assets/third_party/Apache-2.0.txt` at the repository
root. Attribution is included in `NOTICE`, the APK notices, and the preview's
embedded open-source notices.
